decision: Do not manufacture or run the M3.3 assignment proof until both authority and knowledge boundaries are operationally enforced.
required_resolution: M4.1 database-level privilege boundary and assignment/worker integration
real institutional knowledge provider source-backed VERIFIED answers
two explicitly authorized concurrent assignments, actual worker artifacts, independent verification, restart/recovery, dashboard and durable notification proof
status: BLOCKED at live preflight; no shared assignment/service/credential mutation performed
worker_authority_observation: Worker scope is a free-form reference comparison and current DB owner can bypass library checks; no durable grant validation is wired to assignment creation or dispatch.
worker_contract_observation: ContinuousWorker defaults to UnavailableKnowledgeProvider; it cannot authorize work without VERIFIED grounding/preflight/regrounding. The mock provider is test-only.
